name: Qiren Shazhen
source:
Seven girls came to a mountain villa on the outskirts to attend a party. Suddenly they were struck by a storm. They were trapped and lost contact with the outside world. Everyone was caught unawares by the accident, but the conspiracy has just begun.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/885140/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
七个女孩来到郊外的一座山庄参加一个聚会。突然，他们遭遇了一场暴风雨。他们被困并与外界失去了联系。这场意外让所有人措手不及，但阴谋才刚刚开始。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/885140/]Steam[/url]]
